details.further_information: At 16 years and 15 days, the youngest Bundesliga player in the history of FC Bayern Munich.  At 16 years and 15 days, second-youngest player in Bundesliga history.  Father from Germany, mother from Austria.             Paul Wanner is the son of Klaus Wanner (Retired).Paul Wanner is the cousin of Jannik Wanner (Livingston FC).
